text: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 是 macOS 桌面客户端：Electron 窗口启动本机 dsh Web 后端，并载入其提供的本地页面。应用会查找 dsh 命令，也可用 DSH_BIN 指定路径；关闭窗口可隐藏到菜单栏并让后端继续运行。托盘图标按活动会话和任务显示静态或动画状态，右键菜单可切换两种图标样式并调整摆幅。应用提供后端异常重试和版本更新检查，适合希望从原生窗口使用 DSH Web 的用户。需要 macOS 和可用的 dsh 命令。

DeepSeek Harness Desktop runs dsh web in a macOS Electron window. DSH_BIN sets the executable path. The menu bar icon reflects activity; its menu changes icon style and animation. Closing the window hides it while dsh keeps running. The app supports retry and update checks. Requires macOS and dsh.
想从 macOS 的应用窗口直接打开 DSH 的 Web 界面。
有没有能在菜单栏显示 DSH 会话和任务忙碌状态的桌面端？
I want to run the DSH web UI in a native Mac window and keep it available from the menu bar.
DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的功能「启动桌面窗口」：启动本机 dsh Web 后端并在 Electron 窗口载入本地地址；后端异常时可重试。
DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的功能「活动状态托盘」：托盘图标随活动会话和任务变化；菜单可切换图标样式并调整动画幅度。

deepseek-harness-desktop README · ✨ What this is：DeepSeek Harness is powerful, but starting it means opening a terminal and typing `dsh web`. This app wraps it in a **thin Electron shell** — double-click, and it boots `dsh --profile web --no-open --port 0`, waits for the local URL, and renders the **exact same Web GUI** in a native window. Every web feature, zero divergence, zero terminal.

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🐋 The tray icon — alive and switchable：The menu-bar icon is **not a static glyph**. It reflects what DeepSeek Harness is doing:

- **Idle** → a calm, still icon.
- **Working** → an animated icon whose **speed** follows how busy the backend is (running sessions + running jobs).

Right-click the icon to switch between **two styles**:

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：double-click the `.app` — or drop it into **Applications**. If macOS warns on first launch (unsigned build), *right-click → Open*. - **Left-click** the tray icon → show the window - **Right-click** → Open / Quit / Icon Style / Swing Amplitude - **Red close button** → hides to the tray; the app keeps running in the background
🔧 How it works

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：```
DeepSeek Harness.app
  └─ Electron main process
       ├─ resolve dsh (DSH_BIN override → /opt/homebrew/bin/dsh → … → PATH)
       ├─ spawn: dsh --profile web --no-open --port 0

The backend binds `127.0.0.1` on an OS-assigned port, so the `/api` loopback trust fence passes with no extra configuration and there is no fixed-port conflict.

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：> ⚠️ **Do not** open the same session in a separate terminal `dsh web` at the same time — the session store is single-writer, so two live backends writing one session log can corrupt it (history then fails with `corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region`).
📦 Develop / package

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：```sh
npm install          # installs electron + electron-builder
npm start            # run from source
npm run pack         # build the .app (release/mac-arm64/DeepSeek Harness.app)
npm run dist         # also build .dmg and .zip

Output lands in `release/`. If a **Developer ID Application** certificate is in your Keychain, electron-builder signs automatically; otherwise the app is left **unsigned** for local use.

</details>

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：
🔏 Code signing & notarization (remove Gatekeeper) Signing + notarization require an Apple Developer Program membership and a Developer ID certificate. The toolchain and build config are already wired up — you only supply the credentials. **One-time setup**

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：1. Join the [Apple Developer Program](https://developer.apple.com/programs/) (paid).
2. Create a **Developer ID Application** certificate: Xcode → Settings → Accounts → Manage Certificates → `+` → Developer ID Application. Verify with `security find-identity -v -p codesigning`.
3. Create an **App Store Connect API key** (Developer role): [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/) → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → Team Keys → generate → download the `.p8` → note the **Key ID** and **Issuer ID**.

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：**Build + notarize** ```sh npm run pack # signs automatically once the cert is in Keychain APPLE_API_KEY_PATH=~/.appstoreconnect/AuthKey_XXXXXX.p8 \ APPLE_API_KEY_ID=XXXXXXXXXX \
🔄 Auto-update (GitHub Releases) The app checks for updates on launch (then hourly) and offers **Restart now** when a newer version is out. Publish a new release with a GitHub token: ```sh GH_TOKEN=github_pat_xxx ./scripts/publish.sh ```

deepseek-harness-desktop README · 🚀 Getting Started：> Note: reliable macOS auto-update is best with a signed app; for an unsigned personal build it is best-effort.

</details>
